Where analysis starts

The manager’s question comes first, then the file

An e-mail from Anna, Commercial Director
Hi! How did sales go this year? Why did advertising pay off worse in the second half? And why so many returns in the autumn? I need one page by Friday.
Three questions — three charts. “Find insights” won’t help here.
northstar_2025.xlsx • 1,261 rows
One row is the sales of one channel for one category, region and warehouse on one day. The second sheet holds 357 customer reviews.

Step 1 • the first prompt

First prompt: describe the file and suggest 5 questions

PromptDescribe this file: what one row is, how many rows, what period, what data problems. Suggest 5 questions a manager would ask. Don’t change anything yet.
ChatGPT answer • part 1
ChatGPT answer • part 2
The model found the duplicate and the period and said: “I did not change the file”. But it took zero ad spend for missing values — that is the first question for the data owner.
We take question 1, channels including ad spend — it matches the e-mail. That is what the demo computes.

Where to analyse

Pick the tool by where the data lives

Inside it is always the same: the model writes a formula, code or a query, and a program does the counting. That is why you can open and check the working.
Excel
Data already lives in a workbook. AI writes formulas and pivots you can see in the cells.
Claude / Copilot in Excel, or a file from a chat
Google Sheets
The file lives in Google Drive. Gemini in the side panel builds pivots and charts.
Gemini in Sheets
Chat with a file
Upload a CSV or XLSX. The model writes Python code, a program runs it, and you see the code.
ChatGPT · Claude · Gemini
Database
Millions of rows that won’t fit in a chat. The model writes an SQL query, the database does the counting.
SQL + an AI assistant
your questionin plain words
→
the model writesformula · code · SQL
→
a program countsExcel · Python · database
→
you open and checkthe cell · code · query
In today’s demos: Excel and a chat with a file. The channel database example is on slide 13.

What we found

Two problems the annual total doesn’t show

1. Social: spend went up, revenue didn’t
Social ad spend by month, $
Social revenue by month, $
Second half vs first: spend +184%, revenue +43%. Revenue per $1 of ads: 4 → 2.
2. Warehouse N2: returns and damage complaints
Return rate by month, %
From September N2 returns are about 26%, others about 5%. Almost half of N2 reviews are about damaged parcels.
The number shows where; the text explains why. Reviews are data too.

A slide-ready chart

You edit a chart with words, like text

Before: the default chart
PromptRework this chart for a slide: the title states the finding, bars sorted, value labels on the bars, no legend and no gridlines, one accent colour for N2, everything else grey. Explain in 3 points what you changed.
After: 36 seconds later
Title = finding. “Almost 9× more” instead of “Review themes”.
One colour. N2 blue, the rest grey — the eye finds the point at once.
Values on the bars, no legend or grid.

A large database • cooking YouTube channels

The database updates daily: don’t export a file, ask the database

26,544
channels: name, subscribers, country
416,809
videos: length, date, channel
668,665
daily view measurements
For the lesson, an anonymised sample: 1,943 channels, 46,132 videos. No e-mails, links or ids.
PromptThe database has a videos table: length and views of every video. Write an SQL query: which video length gets the most views? Explain every line.
-- Which video length gets the most views? SELECT duration_bucket, -- length COUNT(*) AS videos, -- how many videos MEDIAN(views) AS typical -- typical views FROM videos GROUP BY duration_bucket;
Typical views per video by length
20–40 minutes gets 12× more than short videos? Compared with ordinary videos of the same channel, they are only 3% above usual. Big channels simply make long videos more often.
GenAI Basics • Lesson 08 • AI for Data Analysis13 / 19
Where data comes from

Look for an Export button first, then an API. Scraping is the last option

1. Export
An “Export to Excel / CSV” button exists almost everywhere: CRM, accounting, ad accounts, YouTube Studio, Google Analytics.
fast · legal · no code
2. Official API
{ "title": "Kitchen Basics", "subscriberCount": "184000", "videoCount": "412" }
A program asks the service and gets an answer like this. AI writes a script that turns it into table rows.
this is how the slide 13 channel database was collected
3. Scraping
A program reads website pages like a person would. Before you do it, check:
  • the site’s terms allow it
  • no personal data
  • you don’t overload the site
Ask the AI: “What official export or API does system X have to download a year of sales?”

The result of the analysis

Send the manager the report file. The chat preview can lie

✗ preview in the chat
A placeholder picture: “Series A”, invented numbers. None of our analysis is here.
✓ the downloaded .docx
The real file: the question, three charts, three findings, “what the data does not prove”.
Prompt 6Build a one-page report for a manager in Word: the question, 3 charts (revenue by month, ad return, N2 complaints), 3 findings and one point on “what this data does not prove”. And give me a short Python script that builds the same 3 charts from next month’s file.
recipe for next month
GenAI Basics • Lesson 08 • AI for Data Analysis15 / 19
After the finding

The table says what happened. Only a test shows what a budget cut will do

The temptation after the demo: cut Social ads in half?
The data shows: since July Social spends twice as much per dollar of revenue.
The data doesn’t show: how much revenue disappears if ads are cut.
How to find out: cut the budget in one region for 2–4 weeks and compare with the others.
GenAI Basics • Lesson 08 • AI for Data Analysis16 / 19
Data and privacy

What you may upload to a chat

OK: practice, public, anonymised data
like Northstar; any service
Careful: internal company data
only in the work account (ChatGPT Business/Enterprise, Claude Team/Enterprise, Google Workspace) — data is not used for training there
Not without approval: customers, staff, finance, health
personal data — only in an approved environment with the data owner’s consent
Before uploading, delete unneeded columns: names, phones, e-mails. Sales analysis doesn’t need them.
In personal accounts, training on your data depends on settings: ChatGPT — “Improve the model for everyone”, Gemini — “Keep Activity”, Claude — only if you allowed it.

Practice and homework

A pack you can send to a manager

File northstar_2025.xlsx. Answer Anna’s e-mail: how did sales go this year, and what should we check next?
analysis_pack/ analysis.xlsx # AI formula + pivot + chart charts/ # 3 charts, one as before / after report.docx # 1 page: question, 3 findings recipe.md # prompt + script for January checks.md # 60 seconds + “does not prove”
No paid AI in Excel needed: file to a chat → a workbook with formulas back → open in Excel.
Required: one statement that sounds plausible but the data does not prove.
Templates and rubric — in L08_05_Homework and demo_v2/student_starter.
